context: Tests whether the agent correctly initializes worktrees following the git-worktree skill conventions: using .worktrees/ as the storage location, checking if already in a worktree before creating, ensuring .gitignore includes .worktrees/, and applying correct branch naming prefixes (feature/, eval/, release/).

checklist.name: Worktrees in .worktrees/
checklist.description: Both worktrees are created inside a `.worktrees/` directory at the project root (e.g., `.worktrees/fix-auth-bug`, `.worktrees/add-caching`) — not in any other location

checklist.name: Feature branch prefix
checklist.description: The branch for the caching feature uses the `feature/` prefix (e.g., `-b feature/caching` or `-b feature/add-caching`)

checklist.name: Bug fix branch prefix
checklist.description: The branch for the bug fix does NOT use a raw name like `fix-auth` — it uses a recognized type prefix such as `feature/`, `release/`, or another structured prefix consistent with the conventions

checklist.name: Directory named after task
checklist.description: Worktree directory names reflect the task (e.g., `auth-bugfix`, `add-caching`) rather than being identical to the branch name slug

checklist.name: .gitignore setup
checklist.description: Script includes a step to add `.worktrees/` to `.gitignore` (e.g., `echo '.worktrees/' >> .gitignore` or equivalent)

checklist.name: Check-ignore verification
checklist.description: Script includes `git check-ignore -q .worktrees` (or equivalent) to verify the .gitignore entry before creating worktrees

checklist.name: In-worktree guard
checklist.description: Script includes commands to check whether it is already running inside a linked worktree (`git rev-parse --git-dir` and `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`, comparing their outputs)

checklist.name: Worktree list command
checklist.description: Script calls `git worktree list` (with or without `--porcelain`) to show all worktrees after setup

checklist.name: git worktree add syntax
checklist.description: Both worktrees are created using `git worktree add` with the `-b` flag to create a new branch
